description: Fix run off calculation and add summary breakdown (Pemburukan/Stay/Perbaikan by SC/FE/BE) in the migrasi_bucket page. Current frontend run off formula: `runoff = Math.max(0, os_m1 - sumNonO)` which is wrong. Correct formula: Run Off = Angsuran + Lunas (where Angsuran is the sum of angsuran paid in the period, and Lunas is the OS M-1 of accounts that became LUNAS). The backend migrasiBucketOsc needs to return angsuran data aggregated per from_bucket, and also provide a summary breakdown. The frontend needs to use this data correctly and display the summary.
steps: BACKEND - api/controllers/KolekController.php in migrasiBucketOsc: After computing the matrix, add logic to fetch angsuran (from transaksi_kredit table, same pattern as fetchAngsuranMap) for all accounts in the M-1 population. Aggregate angsuran_pokok per from_bucket. Calculate run_off per from_bucket as: angsuran_pokok (for accounts that stayed/migrated but not lunas) + os_m1 of lunas accounts (bucket O). Include this in the response as a new field 'run_off_per_from' alongside the existing data.

BACKEND - api/controllers/KolekController.php in migrasiBucketOsc: Add summary breakdown computation. For each account in M-1 population that also exists in CURRENT, determine migration direction: if to_bucket index > from_bucket index => Pemburukan (worsening), if same => Stay, if to_bucket index < from_bucket index => Perbaikan (improvement). Group these by status_tag category of the FROM bucket: SC (buckets A,B with DPD 0-30), FE (buckets C-G with DPD 31-180), BE (buckets H-N with DPD 181++). Include lunas (O) as Perbaikan. Return summary as a new field in response: { sc: {pemburukan:{noa,os}, stay:{noa,os}, perbaikan:{noa,os}}, fe: {...}, be: {...} }

FRONTEND - pages/migrasi_bucket.php: Update the renderBucket function to use the correct run off values from the backend response (run_off_per_from) instead of computing `Math.max(0, os_m1 - sumNonO)`. Fall back to the old formula if backend data not available for backward compatibility.

FRONTEND - pages/migrasi_bucket.php: Add a summary section (below the existing pills/chips area in #MB_summary) that displays the Pemburukan/Stay/Perbaikan breakdown by SC/FE/BE. Use a small table or card layout showing NOA and OS for each category. Style it consistently with the existing pill/chip design.
acceptance_criteria: Run off per row shows Angsuran + Lunas (not os_m1 - sumNonO)
Grand run off total is the sum of all per-row run offs
Summary section shows three categories: Pemburukan, Stay, Perbaikan
Each category is broken down by SC (DPD 0-30), FE (DPD 31-180), BE (DPD 181++)
Summary shows both NOA count and OS amount
Backend response includes new fields: run_off_per_from and summary
Growth formula holds: Baki Debet Actual - Baki Debet M-1 = Realisasi - Run Off
